description: PAID ($0.02). Simple statutory interest on a principal at the cited statutory-interest series rate: Actual/365 simple, principal × (rate/100) × (days/365). Pass days, or from and to as YYYY-MM-DD (from inclusive, to exclusive). If both are sent and disagree, the call is refused free. A series with no numeric rate after materialization (mechanism-only) is refused free — a non-answer is not sold. Not legal advice. Jurisdiction-specific compounding and day-count statutes are not applied. Pass api_key if you have one (instant card checkout at /pricing); otherwise the response explains how to pay via x402. Every AE series is free to try. Optional receipt (boolean, default false): on a paid success, include an Ed25519 answer receipt at no extra USDC. An answer receipt is not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} is $0.10 and is not an MCP tool) and is not legal advice. Verify with verify_answer_receipt against /certified/public-key.

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

days.description: Day-count days. Omit when from and to are set. If both are sent and disagree, the answer is refused free (HTTP 400).

from.description: Period start, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Pair with to. Day count is calendar days from inclusive to to exclusive (UTC dates).

principal.description: Principal in the country's own currency. Must be a finite number greater than 0.

receipt.description: Default false. When true, a paid success includes an Ed25519 answer receipt (kind answer_receipt) at no extra USDC. Unpaid 402 and free refusals do not include one. Not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} at $0.10; that SKU is not an MCP tool).

name: compute_statutory_interest

outputSchema.description: Simple statutory interest at the cited rate

confidence_label.description: Evidence verdict derived from source type, verification age and the stale flag (answers: the weakest series read). Rules at /label-rules

coverage_label.description: How much of the question is covered: ready = complete; partial = held with a disclosed limitation or default; gap = no number served. Rules at /label-rules

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

label_basis.description: Inputs and the rule ids that produced the two labels

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card

provenance.description: Cited official sources behind the answer

receipt.description: Ed25519 answer receipt when receipt=true on a paid success

status.description: Answer status, e.g. computed or an honest no-answer status
